thought.text: Now let's start the project. This may pull images and take a while.

reasoning_content:
No sudo. ddev may need sudo for hosts entries — but only if DNS lookup fails. ddev.site wildcard DNS works. Let me try `ddev start`.

Note the router needs ports 80/443. Those are probably free. Let me run ddev start with a longer timeout. ddev start can take several minutes pulling images.

Let me now run ddev start. First set DDEV globally. ddev config is in project. Let's run.

Potential issue: ddev may attempt to write to ~/.ddev (global config) as ddevuser - fine. Also it needs mkcert -install which may need sudo/certutil; ddev can work with untrusted TLS.

Let's run `ddev start` and capture. Timeout 600s. Pulling images might exceed. Let's try.

action.command: cd /workspace && su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev start 2>&1' | tail -60; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
